name: IT Help Desk
description: A complete IT support ticketing system built as a NetPad Application. Includes ticket submission (traditional and conversational AI-powered), ticket search and management, automated routing workflows, priority-based escalation, and Slack notifications. This is a production-ready Application that solves the job-to-be-done: 'Manage internal IT support requests efficiently without enterprise ticketing software.'
summary: Complete IT support ticketing with AI forms, smart search, and automated notifications

inputs.description: Department (engineering, sales, marketing, finance, hr, operations, executive)
Issue category (hardware, software, network, access, other)
Brief subject line describing the issue
How the reporter prefers to be contacted

outputs.description: MongoDB document ID of the saved ticket
Whether confirmation email was sent to reporter
Whether IT team notification was sent
Whether ticket was escalated to Slack (critical only)

sideEffects.description: Sends notification email to IT team
Sends critical ticket alert to Slack channel (critical tickets only)

events.name: ticket.created
events.description: Emitted when a new IT support ticket is submitted

events.name: ticket.confirmed
events.description: Emitted when confirmation email is sent to reporter

events.name: ticket.notified
events.description: Emitted when IT team is notified of the ticket

events.name: ticket.escalated
events.description: Emitted when critical ticket is escalated to Slack

instructions.import: This template creates a complete IT help desk system with ticket submission forms (traditional and conversational AI), smart search interface, and automated workflow routing. Use it to manage internal IT support requests without expensive enterprise ticketing software.
setup: 1. Import the template bundle using the NetPad import API or UI
2. Configure your MongoDB connection in Settings → Connections
3. Configure your email integration in Settings → Integrations
4. (Optional) Configure Slack webhook for critical ticket escalation
5. Update the IT team email address in the workflow (default: it-support@yourcompany.com)
6. Update the Slack webhook URL for critical alerts (if using Slack)
7. Customize department options to match your organization
8. Customize issue categories and conditional fields as needed
11. (Optional) Publish the search form for IT team use
features: Ticket submission with conditional fields based on issue category
Smart search interface with dynamic filters and data-driven dropdowns
Automated email confirmation to ticket reporters
Instant IT team notification with full ticket details
Critical ticket escalation to Slack with alerts
MongoDB storage for searchable ticket history
Conversational AI mode for natural language ticket submission
Section headers and half-width fields for organized forms
customization: Update the department list to match your org structure
Add or modify issue categories (hardware, software, network, etc.)
Customize urgency levels and SLA expectations
Add category-specific conditional fields (asset ID, app name, etc.)
Configure Slack channel for critical alerts
Add workflow actions (create Jira ticket, log to spreadsheet, etc.)
Customize form theme colors and branding
Add additional search filters in the search form
Configure Application permissions for IT team access
